frozen: 2026-11-01, owner instruction (ledgers/approvals.jsonl), before any D2 result exists
status_note: Statements and evidence are those in config/phases.json. Thresholds that read 'proposed default' there are frozen here at those values. The sample sizes and the confidence level are added here, because the statements did not give them. D2 has not started: it needs hardware the owner has not approved buying, and a dated owner approval to connect it. The hardware is the Pixhawk 6X and Orin NX on the Holybro Pixhawk Jetson Baseboard, the OAK-D Pro W and the ARK Flow MR. Carried on the frame, that assembly is about 3.5-4 kg (estimated).
authorization: Motors disarmed and propellers removed throughout. Connecting to the flight controller and any link-cut test each need a dated owner approval (AGENTS.md section 2.3). No arming.
pass_rule: Every trial in a test must meet its threshold. A hand-carried pass is not flight qualification.

measures.camera_imu_offset: estimate with a 95% confidence interval, from at least 3 sessions
measures.frame_consistency: pass/fail: the frame check passes in every session
measures.end_to_end_latency: distribution reported: median, p99 and worst
measures.distortion_model: reported: the model in the unit's factory calibration, and whether the VIO candidate accepts it

ET-D2-1.threshold: offset estimate with a 95% CI; frame check passes in 3/3 sessions; latency distribution reported

reported_not_thresholded: ARK Flow MR optical flow and range on the same routes
ET-D2-2.inconclusive: If the reference does not pass ET-D2-3, this test is inconclusive, not a pass.

ET-D2-3.inconclusive: Inadequate coverage is inconclusive, not a pass.

threshold.freshness_gate_stops_sending: in every trial, independently of the laptop
threshold.no_stale_setpoint_after_resume: In the SIGSTOP and reboot cases: no setpoint older than 200 ms is sent after SIGCONT or after the restart; 3/3 in each of the two cases (owner, 2026-11-02). Age is send time minus the setpoint's generation timestamp, as in freshness.assess, and includes setpoints replayed after a reboot. Evidence: the node's send log with both timestamps, and PX4's received log.

ET-D2-4.note: PX4 selects no action while disarmed, so the action itself is tested in ET-D4-4.
ET-D2-4.method: The Jetson-to-6X link runs in board traces (TELEM2 to UART1, and an Ethernet switch), so the cut is made on the Jetson: the interface down for Ethernet, or the XRCE-DDS agent stopped for the UART. The report names the path carrying offboard and shows that the other carries no setpoints. No cable pull is claimed. This is weaker than a physical cut, and the owner accepted it on 2026-11-02.

cases.link_cut: the interface down for Ethernet, or the XRCE-DDS agent stopped for the UART
cases.process_frozen: the offboard process frozen with SIGSTOP; after SIGCONT no setpoint older than 200 ms is sent (pass/fail)
cases.jetson_reboot: a full Jetson reboot with the flight controller still powered; after the restart no setpoint older than 200 ms is sent (pass/fail); what the node does when it starts again is also reported

ET-D2-4.t0: For the link cut, the logged cut. For SIGSTOP and the reboot, the logged time of the SIGSTOP or of the reboot command on the Jetson. The time of the last setpoint PX4 received is reported in every case.
ET-D2-4.threshold_note: The link-cut threshold applies to each case, the agent's choice. The no-stale-setpoint check after SIGCONT and restart is the owner's, 2026-11-02.

ET-D2-5.note: The statement names the Pixhawk 6X on the Holybro Pixhawk Jetson Baseboard. The ARKV6X option closed with the owner's decision of 2026-11-01.

required_in_the_d2_report.note: Open items from earlier reports that need real hardware. Each is reported with its evidence. None is a threshold, and none moves a pass to a fail by itself.

items.item: Estimator age on the real link, including landing-phase conditions: it reached 92.2 ms against the 100 ms bound in simulation, as a lower bound. Recommend whether the gate should act during landing.
The sensor bound on a real sensor stream. In simulation it had no independent source.

Disarmed, with the real mode switch: the node yields when a mode is selected before arming, as R-07 shows in simulation, and when the switch is already away from Hold at boot. The node sends no arm command in this check.
OAK-D Pro W behaviour in direct sunlight, which is unresolved.
Jetson power on the baseboard: the 12 A UBEC at 7.2 V on a 6S pack down to 3.5 V per cell, on the bench.

blocking_before_armed_flight.item: Explain the early freshness-gate trips: 11 of 131 simulation runs saw `estimator stale` at an armed tick before the fault, first at 102-157 ms against the 100 ms bound, and one tick can latch Land (WO-022 section 7). No armed flight happens until the D2 report explains them.
blocking_before_armed_flight.effect: Blocks any armed flight; checked in ET-D3-4, before the first arm. It does not change a D2 threshold.
blocking_before_armed_flight.explained_means: a cause named with evidence from recorded runs or the real link. 'Cause not established' does not clear it.
